steps.say: Scaled dot-product attention combines packed matrices for a sentence of n words. Queries, keys and values are packed into matrices Q, K and V, then combined as softmax of Q times K transpose over root dk, times V.

Think n rows give one row per word. Q is n by dk and K transpose is dk by n, so their product is n by n scores of every word against every word. Those weights then multiply V, which is n by dv, to give an n by dv output.
